title: Wet 솔로 #114 · super glamour · 샴페인 버건디 · 손 허리 · 가을 단풍길 · 아게하
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail chocolate brown hair, soaking wet, slicked and clinging in wet strands — full body champagne-drenched glistening burgundy fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid wet-look body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a continuous glossy wet-look coating over her entire body, thick sheets and streams of liquid running down every curve in glistening rivulets, countless beads and droplets clinging to the surface and dripping from her chin, fingertips, hips and knees, razor-sharp bright specular highlights along every curve, nothing lying flat. Dense wet surface — BLAZING deep burgundy-wine pigment across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, drenched in fizzing champagne, VIVID golden champagne spraying in a fizzing arc over her and streaming down her body in sparkling rivulets, tiny bubbles and foam bursting on the surface and droplets sparkling in the air, mirror-wet glossy, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same glistening wet burgundy, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same glistening wet burgundy with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
